title: polystichum effusum
intro: Polystichum effusum, commonly known as the Autumn fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a deciduous fern native to Asia and Europe, valued for its potential health benefits and therapeutic uses. Studies have shown that the Autumn fern may possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which could contribute to its potential health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of the Autumn fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds, which may be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial and anti-cancer activities.
